notes: guard_expire must NEVER be played when a counter is confirmed -- that is SFX/SKILL/metal_parry's job (trigger COUNTER_CONFIRMED). It plays only on an unhit guard-window expiry, if the client/server ever exposes that trigger; until then binding is UNSUPPORTED.

basic_blade stays the shared swing default and metal_parry stays the confirmed-counter cue; the 4 weapon identities (dao_swing, brush_stroke, mace_swing, bow_string) are the next block (M39-A CP2), not this checkpoint.
step_grass plays only on grass surfaces; stone, wood and wet mud keep their ported cues. If the map has no authoritative grass-surface flag, binding is UNSUPPORTED, not guessed.
No phase-specific skill keys were created: the catalogue stays 1 cue/skill with shared miss/impact (Gói 39 rules, Q-PHASES unanswered).

All loudness/true-peak/spectral numbers are measured from the real rendered bytes; no ear audition has been done. Spectral distinctness vs the ported baselines is re-measured independently by check_composed_sfx_me_cp2b_guard_grass_v1.py.
